messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: high tail latency observed on inference path (p99 > 4s) impacting streaming responses across eu-west. Auto-escalation to oncall. initial signal at 12:02 UTC :rotating_light:

alex (oncall): saw dashboards. p95 ~ 800ms, p99 spiking 3-5s. Streaming stalls reported from a few customers. Investigating auth/config deps.

anya: flags: featureflag-service errors in last 5m, 502s to controlplane when fetching flags. Also seeing a bump in configfetch errors.

mike: confirmed. controlplane auth token service (token-store) has increased 5xx and retry backoffs. Rate-limiter logs show bursts: `429` -> queueing.

lee: adding quick customer impact note: two active customers (edge-ops, media-gen) reported streaming stalls and partial chunks only. No full disconnects but heavy tail. filing CS ticket #CS-8742.

jessica: escalation to infra? Might be DB auth replica laging. Query latencies for auth_db read replicas at 1.2s.

alex (oncall): can someone run `kubectl get pods -n controlplane` and tail the token-store logs? paste any stacktraces.

mike: running now. tail snippet:

```
kubectl -n controlplane logs -l app=token-store --since=5m
2026-03-15T12:01:17Z ERROR auth: validation failed: read timeout
2026-03-15T12:02:34Z WARN retry: backing off, attempt=4, resp=429
2026-03-15T12:03:11Z ERROR db: conn pool exhausted
```

anya: noticed configfetch call pattern: repeated prefix fetches causing cache misses — likely due to featureflag rollouts. hitting `config-service/v1/fetch?prefix=` endpoints heavy.

ops-bot: deploy bot: Canary rollout for ff/experiment-42 at 11:59 UTC completed (50%). Rolling back recommended? :warning:

alex (oncall): rolling back canary now. mike, can you throttle client retries at edge/gateway so we don't stampede controlplane? set `retry=0` for 2m for configs and token fetch.

mike: pushed temporary gateway rule to drop aggressive retries and cap concurrent fetches to 5.

cody: I'm seeing backpressure signals from kvcache in inference runtime: cache miss rate up 4x leading to extra controlplane fetches. KV cache regen flood. We should prime caches if possible.

jessica: DB team reports one auth_db replica under high IO and WAL replay lag ~ 30s. they're investigating replication. Might be causing the token fetch 5xx.

alex (oncall): mitigation checklist: 1) rollback ff canary (in progress), 2) throttle gateway retries (done), 3) coordinate DB replica failover if needed, 4) prime kvcache and increase local TTLs, 5) customer comms. assign owners.

anya: I'll handle cache priming + TTL bump on runtime side (patch rolling restart small batches).

mike: I'll own gateway retry throttle and follow up with DB ops on replica failover options.

jessica: DB ops doing a controlled promotion if lag doesn't catch up in 3m. Noting possible transient impact for auth writes.

product-support: customer comms drafted: "We are investigating elevated tail latencies impacting streaming; mitigation actions underway. Will follow up within 15 minutes." Sending now to affected customers.

alex (oncall): update: rollback completed at 12:08 UTC. initial telemetry shows p99 dropping to ~1.4s but still above SLO. continuing.

ops-bot: DB ops: replica replay caught up at 12:10:47 UTC.

mike: after replica catch-up, token-store 5xx rate fell by 80%. controlplane request success rate improved.

cody: kvcache miss rate trending down after TTL bump and priming. streaming tail stalls reduced; partial chunks now being completed.

alex (oncall): p95 at 450ms, p99 at 920ms at 12:15 UTC. Not fully back to baseline, but customer impact mitigated.

product-support: customers notified: follow-up note sent, scheduling post-incident summary.

jessica: DB ops will run a thorough postmortem on replica lag root cause (possible compaction IO spike).

anya: action items logged: - audit featureflag rollout safeguards - add kvcache priming on rollout - improve retry/backoff defaults at gateway - add dashboard alert for replica WAL lag impacting token-store

alex (oncall): handing off to next oncall (lee) at 12:30 UTC. if anything regresses, page me. summary pinned to #incidents. :white_check_mark:

lee: taking it. thanks team, will lead postmortem coordination.

incident-bot: Incident resolved -> Severity: S3 (partial degradation, customer impact). Timeline pinned to thread.
